correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed the six initial color-class quotient for S_{a,b}=K_a joined to b isolated vertices. Resting clique signal equals excited clique+fringe population and fringe signal equals excited clique population; each preserves a >=2 threshold after multiplicities truncate to 0,1,2. Independently enumerated all 3^6=729 saturated profiles and checked equality F^8=F^5 for each occupied class. Rechecked recurring-state iff all-rest or the six phase-count inequalities (the all-rest exception explicitly handled), and independently recomputed the multinomial census and a<=3, a=4, a=5 formulas at b=1,2,3,5,8,11. The a>=6 exponent is supplied by three colors each having >=2 clique vertices; inclusion-exclusion gives N_a. A 5-step S(3,3) extinction witness is in the actual proof. The reduction makes 729 exhaustive over arbitrary a,b; eleven small-graph tests are corroboration only.
